record.paper_title: Separability of Topological Groups: A Survey with Open Problems
record.original_question: Can the following two consistency-dependent existence results be proved in ZFC alone: first, that there exist pseudocompact abelian topological groups G and H such that every closed subgroup of G and of H is separable but G x H contains a closed non-separable sigma-compact subgroup; and second, that there exist pseudocomplete locally convex spaces K and L such that every closed vector subspace of K and of L is separable but K x L contains a closed non-separable sigma-compact vector subspace?

evidence.quote: Assume that 2^{omega_1}=c. Then there exist pseudocompact abelian topological groups G and H such that all closed subgroups of G and H are separable, but the product G x H contains a closed non-separable sigma-compact subgroup.
Are Theorems 16 and 19 valid in ZFC alone?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Tychonoff topological space X is called pseudocompact if every continuous real-valued function on X is bounded; X is σ-compact if it is a countable union of compact subsets; X is separable if it has a countable dense subset. A locally convex space L (over the reals) is called pseudocomplete if every Cauchy net contained in some bounded set converges (equivalently, in standard usage, if every closed bounded set is complete).

Decide both of the following in ZFC alone (i.e., without any additional set-theoretic axioms beyond ZFC):

(a) Do there exist pseudocompact abelian Hausdorff topological groups G and H such that every closed subgroup of G is separable, every closed subgroup of H is separable, yet the product G × H contains a closed σ-compact subgroup that is not separable?

(b) Do there exist pseudocomplete locally convex Hausdorff topological vector spaces K and L (over the reals) such that every closed vector subspace of K is separable, every closed vector subspace of L is separable, yet the product K × L contains a closed σ-compact vector subspace that is not separable?

(Both statements are known to be consistent: under the set-theoretic assumption 2^{ω_1} = 𝔠 such groups G, H and spaces K, L can be constructed. The question asks whether the use of an extra set-theoretic hypothesis can be removed.)
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on the class CSS (topological groups in which all closed subgroups are separable) reports the existence in ZFC of precompact abelian examples with G×H ∉ CSS, but the pseudocompact and locally-convex versions of the construction still require extra set-theoretic assumptions (e.g., 2^{ω_1}=𝔠 or 2^{ω_1}=2^ω, MA+¬CH). The explicit question of whether these results hold in ZFC alone is still posed as an open problem in subsequent work by Leiderman–Morris–Tkachenko, with no ZFC proof or refutation located.

status_evidence.title: Topological groups whose closed subgroups are separable, and the product operation
status_evidence.snippet: Examples are given (a) in ZFC for precompact abelian groups; (b) under 2^{ω_1}=2^ω for a pseudocompact abelian group G with G×G ∉ CSS; (c) under MA+¬CH for countably compact abelian groups. The question whether these hold in ZFC alone is posed as an open problem.
status_evidence.claim: The pseudocompact construction requires extra set-theoretic axioms; the ZFC version is left as an open problem.
